test_govcloud_regions_in_config: test that GovCloud regions us-gov-east-1 and us-gov-west-1 are included in AmazonBedrockGlobalConfig
test_govcloud_model_routing: test that BedrockModelInfo.get_bedrock_route returns converse for Claude and Llama models and invoke for Titan models
test_base_model_extraction: test that BedrockModelInfo.get_base_model correctly strips the region prefix from GovCloud model IDs
test_govcloud_model_pricing_verification: test that GovCloud models have approximately 20% higher pricing than their commercial base models
test_govcloud_completion_cost_calculatio: test that completion_cost calculates correct token-based pricing for GovCloud models using region_name parameter
